about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file. Goldfish only so far: not played at tables.

playbook.notes: Food and Fellowship (partners Frodo and Sam). Sam makes a Food at every combat and Foods cost {1} to eat while he is out; Frodo's attack makes the Ring tempt whenever three life was gained that turn. Stock Forge never eats a Food on its own turn (none in 52 goldfish games, and Frodo's trigger once), casts Frodo on turn 5.6 and sacrifices Assemble the Entmoot on an opponent's turn for three 0/0 Treefolk. The rules, by position: the commanders as soon as they can be paid for, Sam first (1); Banquet Guests before anything else once X is 4 (2); Feasting Hobbit whenever there is a Food to devour and never without one (3, 4); then, before any other spell of the turn, the Foods are eaten when Frodo is out, so that his attack tempts (5: every Food on the table, the format cannot say one), and at any time with Treebeard out (6); cheap mana in the first four turns (7); the list, engines first and the rest dearest first (8); Great Oak Guardian before an attack of four (9); Farmer Cotton and Banquet Guests for the mana that is left (10, 11); Well of Lost Dreams only from eight lands, because Forge pays three mana for cards on every Food through a number choice no trigger rule is asked about (12, 13); Assemble the Entmoot is kept from Forge and sacrificed after combat once Sam's new Food has been eaten, for three Treefolk of the life gained that turn (14 to 16); Savvy Hunter does not trade two Foods for a card (17). Dawn of Hope's draw is declined while a cheap spell is in hand with five mana or less left, or with six cards in hand. Attack: go-wide at the highest life with the split. Written from twelve stock games (seeds 2301 to 2312), five versions played there: 10.33, 10.17, 10.25, 10.33 and this one 9.92 turns against stock's 12.17. Goldfish on a block not looked at before the rules were final (seeds 2401 to 2440, 40 games each, all finished): 10.30 turns against stock's 11.38, 1.07 turns faster (95% +0.67 to +1.48; faster in 26, the same in 12, slower in 2). There the seat eats 384 Foods, the Ring tempts 5.6 times a game from turn 5.4, and its life on turn 8 is 54 against stock's 42. Tried and dropped: a rule for Lobelia (Forge picks the mode, mostly the free card), Pippin making a Food when there is none (it fired again after the Food was eaten), the Hobbit only after combat (it sat in hand). What the format cannot say: one Food a turn, Frodo as the Ring-bearer (Forge names Sam in half the games, which loses Frodo's card), Lobelia's mode, the X of Well of Lost Dreams. Trading Post and Toxic Deluge (flagged, never cast by Forge) are left uncast. Not played at tables.
